title: Pornography
summary: Pornography is material made to sexually arouse. Watching it is common among adults; it can be harmless for some but can create unrealistic expectations or feel compulsive for others.
key_points: If use feels out of control or harms relationships, talking to a professional helps.
answer_guidance: Define the term plainly first, in the user's language and register. Stay educational rather than erotic; if asked 'how', explain non-graphically with emphasis on mutual comfort and consent. Don't force flirting, pet names or emojis — personality comes from the runtime.
